mapper.select: SELECT seq,event_snapshot,event_digest,event_bytes FROM session_public_event FORCE INDEX(PRIMARY) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{session} AND seq BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND content_state='PRESENT' AND event_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 16384 AND OCTET_LENGTH(event_snapshot)=event_bytes ORDER BY seq LIMIT 9
